gen-mystery-quest-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi keeps its lowercase oversized and its sans letters clean, with an e that opens clearly to the right. And Mystery Quest does the bookish, nostalgic talking up top, its curved strokes gaping open above compact ascenders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch draws sans-serif letters like rod stock, every curve open enough to see into and every lowercase word big-bodied. Press Start 2P adds the retro fun above, spaced far apart.
gen-righteous-gf-stack-sans-headline: Wide gaps and a deep middle band make Stack Sans Headline crisp and approachable. Righteous, with bowls filling the line like bent steel rod, would feel cramped if shrunk small, while the body font handles size gracefully.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans: Commanding and distinctive, Metamorphous sets its letters with generous sidebearings and a soft fat-to-slim stroke, like a lettering pen held steady. And Sofia Sans answers with a thread of ink, no swelling at all, its tall rounded lowercase open at the side.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Approachable and big-hearted, Schibsted Grotesk gives its e and a tall bowls and terminals that never close in. Gugi supplies the bold, distinctive heading, with lowercase nearly reaching capital height and no stroke modulation, while the plain sans body stays low in contrast.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads approachable and contemporary, its lowercase e wide open and its ascenders tucked compactly above the x-height. And Love Ya Like A Sister brings glass-tube lettering of hollow, constant thickness, so a longer page moves along with a level beat.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-radio-canada: Goldman is bold and wide, with generous clearance between letters. Radio Canada follows with a steady sans line, tall full c, s and z, and open curve endings, so a long page moves along smoothly without any pressure shifts.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-radio-canada-big: Chunky, expressive letters with short ascenders and a tall x-height, held open rather than curled shut, make Grandstander a bold opener. Radio Canada Big, a monoline sans-serif, backs it up.
gen-satoshi-fs-erode: Erode brings a dignified, editorial serif with a gentle ebb and flow. And Satoshi, steady as a technical pen with a commanding x-height, gives the page a modern, approachable front line above it.
gen-silkscreen-archivo: Archivo reads editorial and approachable, its sans-serif curves opening outward with a commanding x-height. But Silkscreen has the stronger personality, lo-fi and retro, with spaghetti-thin lines and space around each letter you can almost feel.
